description: Rows for star names that are also everyday words, read by both parsers' tests (tests/integration/test_voice_everyday_names.py and packages/observation/src/__tests__/voiceParser.everydayNames.test.ts), so the two cannot drift. boundary: [utterance, everyday word], where the naming verb, the name or the word star runs on into a longer word, so the utterance names no star. separators: [label, one character, whether JavaScript's /\s/ takes it]. spaced: [utterance with {s} for that character, everyday word], each asking to select.
